name: Bmy-14802
summary: BMY-14802, also known as BMS-181100, is a drug with antipsychotic effects which acts as both a sigma receptor antagonist and a 5-HT1A receptor agonist. It also has affinity for the 5-HT2 and D4 receptors. The drug reached phase III clinical trials for the treatment of psychosis but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: BMY-14802, also known as BMS-181100, is a drug with antipsychotic effects which acts as both a sigma receptor antagonist and a 5-HT1A receptor agonist.

uses.text: The drug reached phase III clinical trials for the treatment of psychosis but was never marketed.

fact.en: It was one of the first attempts to treat psychosis by blocking sigma receptors instead of dopamine receptors. It reached late stage trials and then stopped.
fact.zh: 它是最早嘗試以阻斷 sigma 受體而非多巴胺受體來治療精神病的藥物之一。它曾進入後期試驗，隨後中止。
fact.zhHans: 它是最早尝试以阻断 sigma 受体而非多巴胺受体来治疗精神病的药物之一。它曾进入后期试验，随后中止。
